items.name: December Series:  Geelong says So-Long 2021
items.information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)

This is a series competition with Kensington 2021.  You may register for **ONLY ONE** competition in the series.  If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events.

If you feel sick, stay at home. If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will not be permitted in the venue. We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

items.name: GuateMaya 2021
items.information:
GuateMaya Open 2021 será el evento que marcará el retorno de las competencias oficiales al país.

Con protocolos de Bioseguridad de las Autoridades Locales y los establecidos por la WCA, GuateMaya busca mantener el desarrollo del speedcubing en Guatemala de la forma mas segura posible para todos nuestros competidores y asistentes.

- Se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia.
- El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.
- Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años

With GuateMaya 2021 we hope to return to hold official competitions regularly in the country.

Using Covid-19 protocols from the local authorities and those sugested by the WCA, GuateMaya 2021 looks forward to improving the local development of the speedcubing in Guatemala, guaranteeing the safety of the competitors and staff.

-Temperature will be measured at the entrance
-Use of masks will be mandatory during all the competition
-Vaccination proof will be required to enter to the venue

items.name: Icelandic Nationals 2021
items.information:
Velkomin!

Ef þetta er fyrsta skipti sem þið eruð að keppa gerir WCA kröfu um **löggild skilríki** í skráningarferlinu. Það er að segja vegabréf, ökuskírteini eða nafnskírteini. *ATH: ekki nægir að koma með debitkort!*

If this is your first time competing you must bring **official identification** as it is required for registration with the WCA. This means passport, driver's licence or other official ID. *Note: Payment cards are not official ID!*

Vinsamlegast lesið upplýsingarnar undir [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) flipanum!



Hlutir sem ber að hafa í huga áður en mætt er til keppninnar:

Haltu þig heima og skráðu þig strax í PCR-sýnatöku hjá Heilsuveru ef þú finnur til einkenna/veikinda. 
Það er grímuskylda inni í salnum.
Einungis 1 gestur fyrir hvern keppanda.
Komdu með þinn eigin penna.
**LESTU [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) FLIPANN FYRIR FREKARI UPPLÝSINGAR!**


Takk fyrir!





Please read the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) information tab!



Things to consider before going to the competition:

Stay at home and sign up for PCR-testing at Heilsuvera if you are feeling ill or are experiencing symptoms.
Only 1 guest per competitor.
Mask use is mandatory.
Bring your own pen.
**READ THE [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) TAB FOR MORE INFORMATION!**


Thank you!
